$comment: First Words (Q0.8): two fittings on the ship’s rail, the speaking tube (to the crew) and the hatch (to the engine room). For the Copilot CLI course: Copilot CLI’s prompt and the shell. Asking the course’s Step 1 prompt through one of them answers the quiz (the right tool is the tube). The reply is the course’s expected output, in its own words, not a transcript (00 §Step 1: Test Copilot CLI). {prompt} is the prompt.
prompt: Say hello and tell me what you can help with

lines.text: A friendly response, listing what Copilot CLI can help with.
Your model, tools, and responses will differ.

text.finishWithJuno: Talk to Juno to finish up at the ship.
text.hint1: Is this a command for the shell, or a request for Copilot?
text.hint2: Requests to Copilot go at its prompt. That’s the brass speaking tube.
text.hint3: I’ve asked it at Copilot’s prompt for you. Listen.
